rw.fuse_staged_v1.description: Staged CTAS chain and fused CTE statement compute the same bag at each boundary (materialization does not change bag semantics).

rw.semijoin_key_reduction_v1.description: Restricting events to cohort keys before an EXISTS window reduction is exact because the reduction is an inner/exists region.

rw.copartition_window_reduction_v1.description: Window reduction per partition after co-partitioning cohort and events by the same normalized opportunity key, hash version and N, followed by additive merge, equals the unpartitioned reduction.

rw.combine_partitions_v1.description: Changing N for an unstarted partitioned suffix preserves results under rw.copartition_window_reduction_v1.

rw.derived_rollup_sum_v1.description: A coarser output grain is obtained by summing additive counts over removed dimensions and recomputing ratios.
